caption: A subwoofer is turned up in a living room, and a picture frame on the wall behind it slowly tilts askew with the bass.

sa.check: A living room with a subwoofer and a picture frame hanging on the wall behind it.
The frame tilts out of level.
The tilt is slow and gradual.
The frame stays on the wall.
Something marks the volume being raised: a hand at a knob, a remote, or the cone beginning to pump.

pc.expect: The frame turns about its hanging point in small jerks, staying against the wall.
pc.fail: The frame swings out from the wall on its hook; or slides sideways along the wall keeping level; or turns in one smooth even sweep; or swings back to level by itself.

pc.expect: The frame moves only while the cone pumps and is still when the cone is still.
pc.fail: The cone pumps for a long spell and the frame never shifts; or the frame jerks while the cone is plainly still; or the frame goes on moving after the cone has stopped.
pc.precondition: The subwoofer's cone or grille is in view.

pc.expect: The frame hangs from its hook and, once tilted, rests in its new pose held by the wall.
pc.fail: The frame rises up the wall; or hangs above its hook; or floats off the wall.

pc.expect: The frame is rigid and the wall solid.
pc.fail: The frame bends; or the wall ripples; or the hanging wire stretches visibly.

pc.expect: One frame, one subwoofer; nothing passes through the wall.
pc.fail: A second frame appears; or the frame vanishes; or sinks into the wall; or the subwoofer turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The picture inside the frame, the wall colour and the subwoofer's look stay the same.
pc.fail: The picture inside the frame changes; or the wall colour changes; or the subwoofer changes size or colour.
